featured_reviews.name: Chandu B
featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointing experience. The staff aggressively pushes you to buy a game card with a minimum recharge of ₹3,100 instead of clearly explaining the available options. The combo packages are poorly designed and misleading they ended up charging us more than the advertised combo prices. To make matters worse, one of the combos included “5 arcade games,” but the card only worked on a limited selection of arcade machines. Many of the games we actually wanted to play either weren’t covered by the combo or weren’t functional at all. Paying a premium only to find several machines out of service made the experience feel like terrible value for money. Definitely not what you’d expect from a place that’s marketed as a premium entertainment destination. Most of the 5 stars reviews are definitely fake!

featured_reviews.name: Chinmay Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text: We went here primarily for bowling. We purchased an offline card. We paid 3100 plus tax(3600) and got 3500 as balance. We also got a BOGO offer in bowling. We selected VIP bowling and it had animation and graphics on the bowling floor and of course the normal bowling was crowded. They have very good combination of arcade and normal games and we had fun here. Staff was very helpful and we had some issues with machine and my card got swiped multiple times. They understood my issue and offered me different games. We collected lot of tickets which acts like a currency for some of the items. They have a free bowling round on birthdays. They also have lot of offers and we got few extra bonus points for their social media posts.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Rajeshirke

The vibe here is superb, and the staff is incredibly cooperative, making the experience even better. featured_reviews.review_text: Fun City at Infinity Mall is a lively indoor amusement zone, perfect for kids and families looking to spend a fun few hours. There’s a good variety of arcade games, rides, and play areas that keep children engaged, while adults can enjoy classic games too. The place is clean, colorful, and well-managed, though it can get crowded on weekends and holidays. Prices are slightly on the higher side, but the overall experience is enjoyable and worth it for a family outing.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Davda
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fun City is a two floor playing paradise for children of all age groups.
They are a number of rides for elder kids, small maze house for young kids to play for 30-45 mins along with arcade games on the top floor which will make your kids fall in love with the place & you might find it difficult to control the expense. They do offer value recharges but honestly the place is expensive for regular visits.
This place is packed on weekends & their charges vary depending on regular working days to weekends / public holidays.
You get their card & if your kid or kids would play regularly at infiniti anderi or malad recharge once with a good value offer as they are valid for a year.
Some Games offer ticket rebates which you can put back in your card, collect few points and buy something from their store on the top floor.

A perfect mall to spend your weekend where you or your family can shop, kids can play a bit & all of you'll can get something to eat at the food court before leaving for home. Mall has ample space for parking, its clean & the crowd is good.

Overall a great place for kids to enjoy their weekend but it does burn a hole in your pocket.
